title: Compact CI pipeline and dependency curation for faster feedback
author: Jordan Patel
release_notes: Improves CI feedback loop by splitting fast/slow test lanes, introduces dependency curation helper for PRs, and adds lightweight CI observability; no breaking changes
description: Context and motivation: CI runtime and noisy dependency churn have been adding 20–30% latency to developer feedback in the monorepo. This PR compacts the CI surface to prioritize fast feedback for common edit paths, extracts a small dep-curation tool to reduce transitive upgrade noise, and adds minimal observability hooks for CI performance. Commits summary: 3 commits — 1) refactor(ci): split lint+unit into fast-lint & slow-lint lanes and introduce fast-test profile; 2) feat(deps): add tools/dep-curator with heuristic-suggest and lockfile-diff commands; 3) chore(ci): add lightweight metrics emitter for job duration and cache hit rates. Changed areas (high level): ".github/workflows/ci-fast.yml" (new fast pipeline), ".github/workflows/ci-slow.yml" (trimmed slow matrix), "tools/dep-curator/curator.py" (new; Python 3.11, small heuristic engine), "scripts/fast-lint.sh" (wrapper that lints changed files only), "pkg/build/cache-keys.go" (compact cache key logic), "docs/ci-observability.md" (how to read CI metrics), minor updates to "redwood/Makefile" and several package.json devDependency pin bumps. Example change snippet: tools/dep-curator now exposes "curator suggest --pr=1234" which outputs a short list of suspect transitive upgrades and a recommended pin list. Review conversation: Elena: "Nice separation — will fast-lint cover staged files only?" Author reply: "fast-lint uses git diff against main by default; added an option to pass a file list for CI containers." Samir: "Can the dep-curator be run as a bot on PR open?" Author: "Yes, added a follow-up Linear task ENG-3499 to wire the GitHub action; curator exposes machine-friendly JSON output." Ravi (security review): "Ensure dep-curator does not execute package scripts during analysis." Author: "Tool uses safe parsing only; documented in README and sandboxed in CI run." Requested changes: adjust cache key to include node-modules metadata hash (addressed in cache-keys.go), add unit tests for curator heuristics (added). Approvals: Elena approved on 2026-02-21, Samir approved on 2026-02-22. CI summary: initial run — fast pipeline green, slow matrix had a flaky integration test (redis-session) which was quarantined and rerun; all checks passing after rerun. Checks: lint (pass), unit (pass), integration (pass after rerun), build (pass), dep-scan (pass). Merge outcome: merged via squash on 2026-02-22; commit message consolidates the above. Migration/ops notes: Ops should watch the new CI metrics dashboard for first 48 hours; added alert docs in docs/ci-observability.md. Follow-ups: wire dep-curator to a lightweight PR bot (ENG-3499), iterate cache-key entropy reduction if cache hit rates drop below 70% in 2 weeks.
